title: W03 to W07 Content Entitlement Decision Binding
purpose: Allow W03, the content authority, to obtain a bounded membership-access decision from W07 without transferring content authority or subscription persistence.

request.subscriberIdentity: X-LuckRead-Principal-User-Id from trusted W01 -> W03 transport; never supplied in request body

invariants: Only W03 is accepted as transport caller for this operation.
Cookie and Authorization headers are forbidden on the W03 -> W07 service request.
W07 is authoritative for membership subscription state and paid-through time.
A decision allows access only for ACTIVE or TRIALING subscription state, matching subscriber and creator, current_period_start <= now < current_period_end, and cancel_at is null or in the future.
W03 remains authoritative for content identity, publication state, accessMode, content body and media references.
No payment, order, subscription or entitlement state is written by this query.
No new Worker, D1, Queue or runtime namespace is introduced.
Unavailable or malformed W07 responses fail closed at W03; membership access is never inferred from client state.
statusRationale: Source integration is proposed in PR #1426; contract admission remains blocked on the repository-wide unified alignment gates.
